title: Unemployment Benefit Claims Training Note: Pension Deductions on a Supplemental Correction
content:
**Which pension is read?** For a supplemental correction on an Unemployment Benefit Claims record, the kind and weekly amount of other pay are those on the corrected week's certification. The rule below turns on a pension the claimant contributed to, measured against the weekly benefit amount.

**How is a claimant-contributed pension deducted?**

| Weekly amount of a claimant-contributed pension | Deduction |
|---|---|
| No more than 0.25 of the weekly benefit amount (the small-pension fraction) | The pension is first reduced by the pension disregard, which is 0.1 of the weekly benefit amount; only the remainder is deducted at the program's claimant-contributed share, rounded to the cent and never below zero |
| Above 0.25 but no more than 0.5 of the weekly benefit amount (the mid-pension fraction) | The whole pension at 0.375 (the mid-pension share), rounded to the cent |

**And any other pension?** Any other pension in a supplemental correction — an employer-funded pension, or a claimant-contributed pension above 0.5 of the weekly benefit amount — is deducted in whole at the program's own share for that kind of pension, with no pension disregard.

**Hypothetical cases (weekly benefit amount 346.00, claimant-contributed share 0.50).** The small-pension limit is 86.50, the mid-pension limit 173.00 and the pension disregard 34.60.

| Claimant-contributed pension | Deduction |
|---|---|
| 80.00 | 80.00 less 34.60 is 45.40; at 0.50, 22.70 |
| 30.00 | 30.00 less 34.60 is below zero; 0.00 |
| 150.00 | 150.00 at 0.375, 56.25 |
| 200.00 | In whole at the program's claimant-contributed share |
